Let's list rows in order:

1. `--autoloading <none|available|all>` | Loading strategy for extensions not bundled in
2. `--base-config <path>` | Config file to load and base initial settings on
3. `--block-size <num>` | Block Allocation Size; must be a power of 2
4. `--checkpoint-on-shutdown`, `--no-checkpoint-on-shutdown` | Whether or not to checkpoint on database shutdown
5. `--checkpoint-wal-size <num>` | Size in bytes after which to trigger automatic checkpointing
6. `--comment <string>` | Extra free form comment line
7. `--data-dir <path>` | Root dir for test data; default WORKING_DIR/data. Relative values resolve per test cwd; absolute/remote (e.g. `az://...`) values are used verbatim.
8. `--database-destroy <on|off|on-success>` | Default on-success: keep on failure
9. `--description <string>` | Config description
10. `--emit-on-skip` | Print a `SKIP_TEST` marker per skipped test
11. `--emit-test-events` | Writes JSON with test events to stderr
12. `--force-reload` | Force reload the test framework
13. `--force-restart`, `--no-force-restart` | Force restart the database between runs
14. `--force-storage` | Test with persistent storage file
15. `--init-script <path>` | SQL script to execute on init
16. `--initial-db <path>` | Initial database path
17. `--keep-home` | Use `$HOME/USERPROFILE` instead of the sandboxed temp-dir home
18. `--max-test-threads <num>` | Max threads to be used by the test runner itself (for e.g. concurrent loop)
19. `--max-threads <num>` | Max threads to use during tests
20. `--on-cleanup <string>` | SQL statements to execute on test end
21. `--on-init <string>` | SQL statements to execute on init
22. `--on-load <string>` | SQL statements to execute on explicit load
23. `--on-new-connection <string>` | SQL statements to execute on connection
24. `--one-initialize` | Initialize buffers with all 1; also see `--zero-initialize`
25. `--require <extension_name>` | If the extension is missing: fail rather than skip tests that require it
26. `--run-id <'auto'|<string>>` | Override per-run identity; the `RUN_ID` path level; shared across a run's tests; auto = generate
27. `--select-tag <string>` | Select tests which match named tag (as singleton set; multiple sets are OR'd)
28. `--select-tag-set <comma-separated strings>` | Select tests which match _all_ named tags (multiple sets are OR'd)
29. `--settings <list[struct]>` | Set [DuckDB configuration]({% link docs/current/configuration/overview.md %}), struct should have keys name and value
30. `--skip-compiled`, `--no-skip-compiled` | Skip compiled tests
31. `--skip-error-messages <comma-separated strings>` | Skip rather than fail tests that fail with a message that contains any of these substrings
32. `--skip-tag <string>` | Skip tests which match named tag (as singleton set; multiple sets are OR'd)
33. `--skip-tag-set <comma-separated strings>` | Skip tests which match _all_ named tags (multiple sets are OR'd)
34. `--sort-style <none|rowsort|valuesort>` | Default sort style if none is configured in the test
35. `--statically-loaded-extensions <comma-separated strings>` | Extensions to be loaded (from the statically available ones)
36. `--stdin` | Read a single sqllogictest script from stdin
37. `--storage-fuzzer`, `--no-storage-fuzzer` | Run storage fuzzer tests
38. `--storage-version <string>` | Database storage version to use by default
39. `--summarize-failures`, `--no-summarize-failures` | Print a summary of all test failures after running
40. `--temp-dir-base <path>` | Override root of the temp-dir tree; may be local or remote (e.g. `s3://`)
41. `--temp-dir-create <never|on-absent|always>` | Default on-absent: mkdir -p, no clobber
42. `--temp-dir-destroy <never|on-success|always>` | Default on-success: keep on failure
43. `--temp-dir-run-id <on|off>` | Is RUN_ID a path level? (default on)
44. `--temp-dir-test-id <on|off>` | Is TEST_ID (the test name) a path level? (default on)
45. `--test-config <path>` | Path to a [configuration file](#configuration-file)
46. `--test-dir <path>` | Override default working directory of test runner, available in tests as {WORKING_DIRECTORY}
47. `--test-env <list[struct]>` | The test variables, struct should have keys env_name and env_value
48. `--test-memory-leaks`, `--no-test-memory-leaks` | Run memory leak tests
49. `--verify-vector <string>` | Run vector verification for a specific vector type (options: dictionary_expression, dictionary_operator, constant_operator, sequence_operator, nested_shuffle, variant_vector)
50. `--zero-initialize` | Initialize buffers with all 0; also see `--one-initialize`
